name: AK19 - Portable Geiger Counter & Nuclear Radiation Detector (Gamma, X-Ray), Cumulative Dose Display
highlights: A Different Category Entirely — Nothing else in this catalogue measures ionising radiation. This is a dedicated instrument for a dedicated question, in the same pocket format as the gas detectors.
Live Rate and Accumulated Dose — The screen carries both the instantaneous reading and the running total, because a brief high reading and a long low exposure are different problems.
Where It Gets Used — Imported goods and building stone, second-hand equipment, travel to areas of concern, and anyone who simply wants their own number rather than a published one.
250 mAh, Rechargeable — USB-C, about an hour to a full charge, 98 g.
100 Per Carton — 465 × 390 × 158 mm outer carton — a specialist line that ships alongside the air quality range without a separate freight arrangement.
